| description = Jaled Dar's spirit slumbers in his crypt in the Dragon Necropolis. He was of the First Brood and the leader of the break away faction the Ring of Scale. A believer in the dominance of dragonkind over all others he sympathized with those who stood by Kerafyrm (The Sleeper). Departing Velious he and the Ring of Scale made a new home in Kunark where they warred with the Iksar Empire. Jaled'Dar met his end over the Field of Bone where he and Emperor Ganak destroyed one another in a battle of dragon fire and dark magic.

Bitter, he seeks to have the seal preventing Kerafyrm's awakening destroyed and a new age of dragon dominance over Norrath.
